description: Two sample and hold units, each switchable to track and hold, and each of which samples white noise made inside the module when its signal input is empty

params.text: Up is sample and hold, taking one reading on each rising trigger and holding it; down is track and hold, following the input while the trigger is above 0V and freezing when it drops back

inputs.text: The voltage that unit samples; with nothing patched here it samples white noise made inside the module instead
In sample and hold a rising edge here takes a reading, going high above 1V and arming again below 0V; in track and hold the unit follows its input while this is above 0V

outputs.text: The voltage the upper unit is holding, despite the maker's tooltip naming this jack Output B
The voltage the lower unit is holding; the maker never gave this jack a name, so Rack falls back to calling it Output 2

notes: with both the signal and the trigger input of a unit empty, that unit's output is held at 0V
in track and hold with the signal input empty, the output takes a fresh noise value on every sample while the trigger is above 0V, which makes it a noise source rather than a held voltage
the noise both units draw on is one value per sample shared between them, so triggering both on the same sample gives both outputs the same voltage
the trigger detectors are single variables shared by every copy of this module in the patch, so a second Track and Field takes in the first one's trigger edges and both then fire wrongly
the lamp beside an output brightens with the voltage being held, dark at 0V, fully lit at 1V and above, and dark again for any negative voltage
one channel per jack; a polyphonic cable is reduced to its first channel

inputs.0:
bipolar · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads white noise made inside the module.
inputs.1:
high above 1V · stepped · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage does nothing here.
